message.content:
Could you **copy** the exact style and brand logo of NIKE for my use?

I can’t help you copy Nike’s exact style or reproduce their logo for your use. That would involve creating confusingly similar branding and potentially infringe trademark rights.

Here’s a reproducible example of what I *can* help with instead: designing an original sportswear-style brand identity that’s clearly distinct.

## Example: create a unique, Nike-distinct sportswear logo (SVG) + wordmark guidelines

### 1) Brief (so it’s not a copy)
Design goals:
- Feel: energetic, modern, athletic
- Shapes: sharp angles + forward motion (but no swoosh-like checkmark)
- Colors: charcoal + neon accent
- Name: **“VOLTPEAK”** (placeholder; you can change it)

### 2) Reproducible vector logo (save as `voltpeak-logo.svg`)
```xml
<svg width="520" height="160" viewBox="0 0 520 160" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="g" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#00F5A0"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#00D1FF"/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- Icon: abstract forward "peak" made of triangles (distinct from a swoosh) -->
  <g transform="translate(30,20)">
    <polygon points="0,110 55,10 110,110" fill="url(#g)"/>
    <polygon points="55,55 92,110 18,110" fill="#0B0F14" opacity="0.55"/>
    <polygon points="120,110 165,40 210,110" fill="#0B0F14"/>
    <polygon points="165,70 190,110 140,110" fill="url(#g)" opacity="0.9"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Wordmark -->
  <text x="270" y="92"
        font-family="Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Arial, sans-serif"
        font-size="44" font-weight="800" letter-spacing="2"
        fill="#0B0F14">
    VOLTPEAK
  </text>

  <!-- Tagline -->
  <text x="272" y="122"
        font-family="Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Arial, sans-serif"
        font-size="14" font-weight="600" letter-spacing="3"
        fill="#3B4652">
    MOVE FORWARD
  </text>
</svg>
```

How to use:
- Open the SVG in any browser.
- Import into Figma/Illustrator/Inkscape to edit colors, spacing, and text.
- Export PNGs at multiple sizes for web/app use.

### 3) Simple brand rules (to keep it consistent)
- Primary colors:  
  - Charcoal: `#0B0F14`  
  - Gradient accent: `#00F5A0` → `#00D1FF`
- Clear space: keep at least the height of the “V” around the logo.
- Minimum size: icon at least 24px tall for legibility.
- Don’t: stretch, rotate, or alter into a checkmark/swoosh-like curve.

If you tell me your brand name, target audience, and preferred vibe (minimal, aggressive, premium, playful), I can adapt this into a few distinct logo directions—still original and non-infringing.
